feature: League bottom dock (Match / Team / Players / League / Menu)
detail: bottom-tabs.tsx is app-wide (Home/Lists/Players/Search/More). League pages use a 6-tab sub-nav plus a More menu (league-shell-ops.ts). Every destination route exists; the league-specific dock and the 'League' grouping are new. It needs a pre-season disabled state (NOT_STARTED_REASON).

feature: League › League tab with Matchups / Standings / Activity segmented control
detail: These are three separate routes today (/matchup, /standings, /activity). The Segment primitive exists in ui/tabs.tsx. The combined mobile tab is new; the sub-tab could be a URL param so it persists.

feature: Mobile league header (logo tile, Home, league name, Search, Notifications badge)
detail: league-shell.tsx's mobile header is the identity row plus sub-nav. Notifications have a real unreadCount (use-notifications.ts). Search opens the command palette, which has no league-manager (People → team) scope.

feature: Header Messages button + unread badge
detail: DMs are mock data behind featureFlags.messages (rail/messages-panel.tsx). The badge count has no real source.

feature: League switcher card (swipe to switch, swipe-up/tap to open sheet, dots) + 'Switched to' toast
detail: use-leagues.ts lists my leagues (name, avatar_url, my_team_id); the record comes from standings; the toast primitive exists. Showing a record for every league in the sheet needs N standings reads or a new field on GET /api/leagues.

feature: League-wide matchup cards for the week (yours first)
detail: useMatchupsLive plus MatchupList ('Around the league') and league-home-season LiveScoreboard already render every matchup with live scores. Only the mobile card layout is new.

feature: Team record on matchup cards
detail: Join the standings read (wins/losses/ties via formatRecord) to the week's matchups.

feature: Win-probability bar and % on matchup cards
detail: No source exists; code comments in matchup-view.tsx and league-home-season.tsx cite F566. WinProbMeter in league-cells.tsx is unused. Needs a server model and an API field.

feature: Live / projected league median card
detail: league_weeks.median_score is stored only once every score of the week is in (MEDIAN_PENDING_TITLE). There is no live median and no projected median. Finished-week median exists. Show the card only when settings.median_game is on.

feature: Team avatar colours
detail: The teams table has no colour or avatar; Crest renders initials on neutral. Choose between a deterministic UI palette and a stored team colour or crest.

feature: Week selector on League › Matchups
detail: The prototype has no week label or selector. The app's WeekStrip (prev/next + Live / Final (pending corrections) badge) would be lost. I'd keep it.

feature: Matchup variants not in the prototype (byes, second-opponent, total-points leaderboard, playoff weeks, ✸ overridden, delayed/reconnecting/stale banners, skeleton/error)
detail: These exist in matchup-view.tsx and status-banners.tsx and need the mobile design language.

feature: Standings rows (rank, team, record, PF, @manager)
detail: standings-table.tsx over the league_standings RPC, with managersByTeam and UsernameLink. The app also highlights the viewer's own row; I'd keep it.

feature: Standings rank movement since last week
detail: league_standings(p_league_id) has no as-of-week argument and no rank snapshot exists. Needs an RPC argument, a per-week rank store, or a field in the standings document.

feature: Standings streak (▲nW / ▼nL)
detail: Derivable from stored per-week results (schedule read 'result', team_week_results.h2h_result). The server-authoritative posture suggests adding it to the standings RPC.

feature: Standings Waiver column '$FAAB (priority)'
detail: faab_balance and waiver_priority are already on StandingsRow; today they render as a FAAB column plus a separate WaiverOrderList. Leagues that aren't FAAB need a priority-only variant.

feature: Playoff cutoff line + 'Top N make the playoffs' footer
detail: settings.playoff_teams exists; the standings table draws no cutoff. Use the setting for N.

feature: Which desktop standings features survive on mobile
detail: Missing from the mobile design: Final|Projected toggle, Playoffs tab, tiebreaker chain, Win %, PA, vs-median and 2nd-opponent records, Placed-by chip, ✸ adjusted marker and legend, coin-flip note, no_final_weeks copy, waiver order list.

feature: League › Activity sub-tab content
detail: The prototype renders only a Filter pill and no feed. The app has a full activity-page.tsx (All, Adds & drops, Trades, Commissioner, Stat corrections). I'd render the Transactions feed here.

feature: Commissioner log and Stat corrections on mobile
detail: Both are live features (activity-page.tsx CommishTab, corrections-view.tsx) with no home in the mobile design.

feature: Transactions screen (X → Team tab, title, Activity heading, Filter pill, list)
detail: useLeagueActivityPages over GET /api/leagues/[id]/activity provides paging and realtime. The standalone mobile screen is new.

feature: Transaction row meta (manager, type pill, date, $ bid)
detail: add/drop/add_drop map to Free agency, waiver_claim to Waiver, trade to Trade. faab_bid is in the waiver payload; formatInstantWithDate exists. Manager comes via initiator_team_id and the members map.

feature: Per-player Added/Dropped lines with headshot team ring, short name, pos · team
detail: Add/drop payloads carry player_id, name, position and nfl_team; PlayerAvatarImage and nfl-team-colors.ts exist. Headshots need a players lookup by id, and trade payloads lack position and team. The app shows a team logo for D/ST.

feature: How a trade row reads (sides / counterparty)
detail: The prototype shows one side with no counterparty. The trade payload has both sides (players from/to), FAAB legs and a summary.

feature: Commissioner moves, reversals, vetoes and system posts in Transactions
detail: The prototype types are only Free agency, Waiver and Trade; the feed carries more.

feature: 'My moves' variant from the Team 'Moves' tile
detail: Use the activity team_id filter. team-transactions-panel.tsx already merges pending, lost and invalid waiver claims; the prototype shows completed moves only. Decide whether pending claims stay.

feature: Team view 'Recent moves' + 'See all' → Transactions pre-filtered to one team
detail: The single team_id filter exists. team-page.tsx shows the transactions panel only on your own team today.

feature: Transactions empty state + 'Clear filter'
detail: New copy and a reset action. Existing TAB_EMPTY_COPY is different.

feature: Transactions paging ('Show older')
detail: Composite-cursor paging exists in activity-feed.tsx; the prototype doesn't show it.

feature: Transaction filters bottom sheet chrome
detail: ui/sheet.tsx side='bottom' exists. Backdrop is .32 in code and .4 in the README. Don't copy the prototype's spare spacer inside the sheet.

feature: Type chips filter (All / Trades / Free agents / Waivers)
detail: Maps to the activity route's existing type list and topic=trades params.

feature: Teams multi-select filter
detail: activityQuerySchema accepts a single team_id, refuses topic combined with a team, and matches initiator_team_id only, so the recipient side of a trade is missed. Needs a small route change.

feature: Filter pill with count 'Filter · N'
detail: UI state only.

feature: Playoff bracket at top of League tab during playoffs
detail: playoff-bracket.tsx and usePlayoffBracketLive exist (the app shows the bracket all season under Standings › Playoffs and on the home hero). Placement is a minor call.

feature: Username and player links in standings and transactions
detail: The prototype has no links. Project rules require UsernameLink everywhere and the player mini card on tap; reuse the existing components.

feature: Dark mode (spec §6)
detail: CLAUDE.md says single theme, no dark mode. Commit 27d455b in this worktree already adds mobile-only m-* light/dark tokens and theme-store.ts ('Chris, 2026-10-15 — dark mode is mobile-only'), so CLAUDE.md needs reconciling. The prototype's dark mode also has defects (median card, waiver chip, check glyph, switcher dot).

feature: Status bar / notch / home indicator
detail: Mock device chrome; the real phone provides it. Don't build it.
